missing.what: tiktoken GPT-2 BPE files downloaded from OpenAI's public blob storage
missing.why: tiktoken.get_encoding("gpt2") fetches the encoder files over HTTPS (openaipublic.blob.core.windows.net) on first use and caches them; the map lists tiktoken only as a library, so the BPE prep scripts and sample.py have an outside dependency the map does not show.

missing.what: Multi-process DDP topology: torchrun workers joined by an NCCL process group (single or multi-node)
missing.why: A GPT-2 run is N train.py processes (RANK/LOCAL_RANK/WORLD_SIZE), init_process_group(backend='nccl'), optionally across nodes via master_addr/master_port; gradient_accumulation_steps is divided by world size and only rank 0 evaluates/logs/checkpoints. The map folds this into one component and has no node or flow for the peer processes or the inter-GPU all-reduce.

missing.what: No flow for the main train-from-scratch path (or for resume)
missing.why: The quick start (python train.py config/train_shakespeare_char.py) and the GPT-2 reproduction both start from init_from='scratch' (vocab from meta.pkl or 50304); resume restores weights, optimizer, iter_num and best_val_loss. Only the finetune start has a flow, so the most common entry point is covered only by edges.
